ticker_text: Frontend Developer             •             Based in Stuttgart             •             Open to work             •             Available for remote work             •
i_am_marc: Hey there, I'm Marc! My journey into frontend development is driven by a passion for creating clean, interactive, and user-friendly web applications. For me, coding isn't just about writing lines of text—it's the perfect mix of logical problem-solving and creative design. What inspires me most is the ability to turn a blank screen into a digital experience that actually helps people in their daily lives.
based_in: Based in the Stuttgart area, Germany. While I love where I live and am not looking to relocate, I am highly motivated to work in hybrid or fully remote setups, bringing my dedication directly to your digital workspace.
what_i_love: The tech world moves fast, and that’s exactly what I love about it. I have a strong growth mindset and genuinely enjoy diving into new technologies, modern frameworks, and best practices to constantly level up my skills.
brief_description: When tackling code challenges, I rely on a mix of analytical thinking and creativity. I don't just look for a quick fix; I persist until I find an efficient and elegant solution. For me, every bug is a chance to learn, and I highly value collaboration and team feedback to achieve the best results.
short_intro: Throughout my intensive training at the Developer Akademie, I have built a solid foundation in core frontend technologies like HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript. I thrive on bringing designs to life with clean, modular code. However, for me, web development isn't static. Keeping up with the rapid pace of modern frameworks and tools is what makes this field so exciting. I am highly adaptable and always eager to learn, test, and master new technologies to build the most efficient digital solutions possible.
feel_free: feel free to contact me. I look forward to expanding on my previous knowledge.
project_prev: Explore a section of my work here - Interact with projects to see my skills in action.
what_my: What my colleagues say about me
janisch: Marc has proven to be a reliable group partner. His technical skills and proactive approach were cruicial to the success of our project.
fischer: I had the good fortune of working with Simon in a group project at the Developer Akademie that involved a lot of effort. He always stayed calm, cool, and focused.
scholz: Our project benefited enormously from Marcs efficient way of working.
contact_text: I am currently looking for a position as a Junior Frontend Developer in the Stuttgart area or in a fully remote setup. If you are looking for a motivated developer who writes clean, maintainable code, loves solving tricky UI challenges, and brings a strong commitment to your team, let's connect! I'm ready to bring your designs to life and add real value to your upcoming projects from day one. Drop me a line — I look forward to hearing about your ideas!

ln_sec1_p: The controller responsible for data processing on this website is:
ln_sec2_p: This privacy policy explains which personal data is processed when you visit this portfolio website or contact me via the contact form. Personal data means any information that can be used to identify you personally, for example your name, email address or message content.
ln_sec3_p1: When you visit this website, technically necessary access data may be processed automatically by the hosting provider. This can include the requested page or file, date and time of access, browser type and version, operating system, referrer URL and IP address.
ln_sec3_p2: The processing is necessary to deliver the website, maintain technical stability and ensure security. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. The concrete retention period depends on the hosting provider used and should be adjusted after deployment.
ln_sec4_p1: If you use the contact form, the data entered there is processed. This currently includes your name, email address and message. The data is used only to answer your request and to communicate with you.
ln_sec4_p2: The legal basis is your consent pursuant to Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR. You can withdraw your consent at any time with effect for the future by sending an email to marc.dev@web.de. The legality of processing carried out before withdrawal remains unaffected.
ln_sec5_p: If you contact me by email, your email address and the content of your message are processed so that I can respond to your request. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. If your request relates to pre-contractual measures, Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR may also apply.
ln_sec6_p: This portfolio website does not intentionally use tracking cookies, analytics tools or advertising services. Fonts, images, styles and scripts are intended to be loaded locally from this website. If external services, analytics tools or embedded content are added later, this privacy policy must be updated accordingly.
ln_sec7_p: Your data is not sold or shared for advertising purposes. Data may be processed by technical service providers, especially hosting and email service providers, where this is necessary to operate the website and handle your request.
ln_sec8_p: Contact requests are stored only for as long as necessary to process the request, unless statutory retention obligations apply. Server log files are stored only for as long as technically necessary or as specified by the hosting provider.
ln_sec9_p1: You have the right to request access to your personal data, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection to processing. If processing is based on consent, you also have the right to withdraw your consent at any time with effect for the future.
ln_sec9_p2: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection supervisory authority.
ln_sec10_p: This website should be delivered via HTTPS after deployment. HTTPS protects data transmitted between your browser and the website against unauthorized access as far as technically possible.
ln_sec11_p: This privacy policy may be updated if the website, hosting setup, contact form, external services or legal requirements change.
